messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

To compare our VNA solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without unsupported claims, the needed evidence would have to directly tie together the Semiconductor / SoC application, the R&S VNA solution configuration, the named competitor product, and the comparison basis or result in the same supported source; the current passages only provide separate pieces, not a full supported comparison [56][59].
- Existing competitor-linked evidence: the LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, Strength: total solution including probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool with local partner TeraBit Solutions / AtaiTec, and DUT: Board to Board Connector [56].  
- Existing SoC / RFIC application evidence: the Bare Board for SoCs project lists Advantest and Meritech, application as PCB test with probing including impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, offered solution as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and “what does it take to win” as Partners [59].  
- Existing market targeting evidence: the sales strategy lists target customer groups ICR, WIC, ADT, AUT; industry as Bare board for SoCs (RFIC); fit as VNAs; companies as suppliers of Samsung Electronics; and comments as evaluation of socket and transmission line [59].  
- Existing solution-pattern evidence: the cited win factor is not a single instrument specification but a total solution of probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner [26].  
- Current gaps: the LSmtron source does not provide formal legal name, location, website, department, purchase date, project name, ZNB40 formal model page, order number, frequency range, configuration, or whether it was purchase, evaluation, PoC, or only a sales success story [55].  
- Current gaps: the TRI_AMD_RSKR source lacks formal release date, slide version, author, release audience, and has unresolved issues including ZNB40 not mapped to a formal R&S model page and unclear field layering for ATS, ZVA67, and ZNA43 [57].  
- Therefore, the required evidence is a direct Semiconductor / SoC case source that names the customer or target segment, DUT/application, exact R&S VNA model and options, probe/mount-kit/de-embedding/partner configuration, named competitor product, identical measurement conditions and metrics, and the factual comparison outcome; the current passages do not provide that complete direct link [56][57][59].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。

- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。

- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。

To compare our VNA solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without unsupported claims, the needed evidence would have to directly tie together the Semiconductor / SoC application, the R&S VNA solution configuration, the named competitor product, and the comparison basis or result in the same supported source; the current passages only provide separate pieces, not a full supported comparison [56][59].
- Existing competitor-linked evidence: the LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, Strength: total solution including probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool with local partner TeraBit Solutions / AtaiTec, and DUT: Board to Board Connector [56].  
- Existing SoC / RFIC application evidence: the Bare Board for SoCs project lists Advantest and Meritech, application as PCB test with probing including impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, offered solution as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and “what does it take to win” as Partners [59].  
- Existing market targeting evidence: the sales strategy lists target customer groups ICR, WIC, ADT, AUT; industry as Bare board for SoCs (RFIC); fit as VNAs; companies as suppliers of Samsung Electronics; and comments as evaluation of socket and transmission line [59].  
- Existing solution-pattern evidence: the cited win factor is not a single instrument specification but a total solution of probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner [26].  
- Current gaps: the LSmtron source does not provide formal legal name, location, website, department, purchase date, project name, ZNB40 formal model page, order number, frequency range, configuration, or whether it was purchase, evaluation, PoC, or only a sales success story [55].  
- Current gaps: the TRI_AMD_RSKR source lacks formal release date, slide version, author, release audience, and has unresolved issues including ZNB40 not mapped to a formal R&S model page and unclear field layering for ATS, ZVA67, and ZNA43 [57].  
- Therefore, the required evidence is a direct Semiconductor / SoC case source that names the customer or target segment, DUT/application, exact R&S VNA model and options, probe/mount-kit/de-embedding/partner configuration, named competitor product, identical measurement conditions and metrics, and the factual comparison outcome; the current passages do not provide that complete direct link [56][57][59].
